title: Does talking to an AI change how you think?
body: No peer-reviewed study tests how voice conversation with an AI affects memory, composition or thinking. The one widely cited study of AI and thinking was typed, and is an unreviewed preprint.
foot: 4 Oct · from Typomora research

title: Does typing weaken speaking?
body: No study shows that heavy typing degrades speech production, or that heavy speaking improves typed composition. Whether practice in one carries over to the other is untested.
foot: 4 Oct · from Typomora research

title: Does dictation train speech?
body: No peer-reviewed study shows that dictation or speech-to-text improves unaided spoken fluency or confidence. Speech-recognition feedback does improve pronunciation, which makes it a testable idea.
foot: 4 Oct · from The Computing Environment and Sensory Syncrasis
from: The Computing Environment and Sensory Syncrasis

title: Do screens shift the balance of the senses?
body: Nobody has measured whether what children watch or play changes which sense dominates when sight and sound compete — the closest measurable form of McLuhan's sense ratio.
foot: 4 Oct · from Screens and ADHD evidence base

title: Inner speech in ADHD
body: No study had looked specifically at inner speech in ADHD as of a 2015 review, and no study has tested whether naming a feeling calms it less in ADHD.
foot: 4 Oct · from Screens and ADHD evidence base

title: What influenced the AI's purchase?
body: No AI company reports which pages or sources shaped what its shopping assistant bought, in a form anyone else can check. Until one does, nobody outside it can measure an ad's effect on an AI buyer.

title: Does the same basket cost more on your phone?
body: Nobody has measured whether online prices in Canada change with your location, device or history. The US has a federal study; Canada has little enforcement and almost no documentation.

title: Books kept on the publisher's side

title: A referral that survives a remix
body: Of eleven products checked, only Framer documents a referral parameter that carries through a remix, duplicate or template link. Everywhere else the credit is lost at the copy.

title: Timing antivirals to the body clock

title: A tax on money that sits still
body: No one has seriously built a Pigouvian tax on hoarded, immobile capital. The closest precedent is demurrage — a fee for holding currency.
